hero.title: Durania
hero.subtitle: The Silver Cup
hero.description: Discover a natural paradise in the heart of Norte de Santander. Coffee, nature, culture and adventure await you.

nature.title: Nature & Adventure
nature.subtitle: Immerse yourself in the green landscapes, trails and water bodies that make Durania a unique destination.

hiking.title: Hiking
hiking.desc: Walk paths surrounded by lush vegetation and stunning views of the Norte de Santander coffee landscape. Hire local guides for the full experience.

birds.title: Bird Watching
birds.desc: Durania is a refuge for dozens of bird species. Its tropical climate and diverse vegetation make it an ideal destination for birdwatching lovers.

rivers.title: Rivers & Pools
rivers.desc: The Zulia River, streams La Lejía, La Ocarena and Coladera, along with the famous Pozo del Amor and Pozo de la Hamaca at Laguna de la Barca, offer refreshing aquatic experiences.

lagoon.title: Laguna de la Barca
lagoon.desc: 55 minutes from the central park, this lagoon is the municipality's natural treasure. Surrounded by mountains and nature, it's perfect for relaxation and adventure.

waterfall.title: El Saladito Waterfall
waterfall.desc: An impressive waterfall of approximately 30 meters high located in the El Almendral village. A natural spectacle you cannot miss.

gastronomy.title: Gastronomy
gastronomy.subtitle: Durania's cuisine fuses traditional Santandereano flavors with fresh countryside ingredients.

items.name: Norte Santandereano Mute
items.desc: Traditional soup prepared with corn, pork, giblets and local spices. The most emblematic dish of the region.

items.name: Carnes a la Vara
items.desc: Meats slowly roasted over embers on a wooden spit, an ancestral technique that preserves all the juices and flavors.

items.name: Roasted Goat
items.desc: Local goat, raised on natural pastures, is a delicacy that reflects the livestock wealth of the municipality.

items.name: Durania Coffee
items.desc: Coffee grown on mountain slopes, with unmatched aroma and flavor. The reason Durania was called 'The Silver Cup'.

items.name: Honey & Bee Products
items.desc: Pure locally harvested honey, along with pollen and propolis, direct products from Durania's beehives.

items.name: River Fish
items.desc: Fresh fish from the Zulia River and local streams, prepared with traditional peasant cuisine recipes.

apiculture.title: Apiculture & Apitourism
apiculture.subtitle: Live the unique experience of becoming a Guardian of the Bees and discover the fascinating world of honey.

what.title: What is Apitourism?
what.desc: Apitourism is one of the most sustainable forms of tourism. It combines knowledge of the bee world, the practice of beekeeping and its vital role in biodiversity, with local gastronomic experiences and direct contact with nature.

tour.title: Day Tour
tour.desc: From Cúcuta (47 km), departing at 6:30 AM from Parque Colón. Includes specialized transport, typical lunch, full protective equipment and apicultural kit with honey as a gift.

includesList: Apiculture kit with honey (143g) and dried fruits
Educational workshop on honeys and hive products

agriculture.title: Countryside & Agriculture
agriculture.subtitle: Discover the agricultural wealth that sustains and gives identity to the municipality of Durania.

items.title: Coffee Growing
items.desc: Coffee is the soul of Durania. Visit coffee farms, learn about the collection, processing and roasting of mountain coffee.

items.title: Livestock
items.desc: Cattle and goat farming is an economic pillar. Goat and dairy products are a reflection of this productive tradition.

items.title: Fish Farming
items.desc: Fish cultivation in natural ponds. Visit fish farms and enjoy the freshest fish directly from the source.

items.title: Agrotourism Farms
items.desc: Experience rural life: harvest fruits, learn about crops and enjoy campesino hospitality on local farms.

culture.title: Culture & History
culture.subtitle: Durania holds centuries of history, from indigenous peoples to the traditions preserved today.

history.title: Municipal History
history.desc: Durania was originally inhabited by the Oporomas tribe, a result of Karib-Chibcha mixing. The municipality's name honors General Justo Leónidas Durán, a 19th century liberal revolutionary. It was known as 'The Silver Cup' for its coffee production boom.

sites.title: Historic Sites
list: Casa de la Cultura (Casa del General Rafael Leal)
Virgen del Carmen Monument (3 km from center)

traditions.title: Traditions
traditions.desc: Duranenses are known for their hospitality, joy and pride in their roots. The San Nicolás patron saint festivals, vallenata and carranguera music, and local crafts are living parts of their cultural identity.

events.title: Fairs & Events
events.subtitle: The municipality of Durania celebrates year-round with fairs, festivities and events that bring the entire community together.

items.title: La Gran Cabalgata
items.desc: Spectacular horseback parade through the streets of the municipality during Durania's Ferias y Fiestas celebrations.

items.title: Copla & Trova Festival
items.desc: Music festival at the Main Park where trovadores and copleros showcase their talent in a night full of culture and tradition.

items.title: Mercado Campesino
items.desc: Exhibition and sale of local farm products: coffee, honey, fruits, vegetables and crafts made by the region's farmers.

items.title: Desfile de Comparsas
items.desc: Traditional parade of comparsas that fills the streets with color, music and joy during the patron saint festivities.

lodging.title: Lodging
lodging.subtitle: Find the perfect place to rest in Durania, from rural farms to traditional inns.

types.title: Tourist Farms
types.desc: Stay on farms surrounded by nature, with country breakfast included, hammocks and views of the coffee landscape.

types.title: Country Inns
types.desc: Family accommodation in the heart of the municipality, with traditional cuisine and personalized attention from local hosts.

types.title: Mountain Cabins
types.desc: Rustic cabins in the midst of nature, perfect for disconnecting and enjoying the silence and country breeze.

types.title: Hotels in Town
types.desc: Simple and comfortable hotels in the municipal center, close to historic sites and the main park.

lodging.contact: For bookings and availability, contact us directly.

realEstate.title: Real Estate
realEstate.subtitle: Durania is the ideal place to live, invest or have your retreat farm in the midst of nature.

types.title: Farms for Sale
types.desc: Rural properties with arable land, water sources and panoramic views. Ideal for agribusiness or rural tourism.

types.title: Farms for Rent
types.desc: Farm rentals by season or permanent for families, groups or entrepreneurs in the tourism sector.

types.title: Rural Lots
types.desc: Lots with deeds in high-potential areas for building country homes or ecotourism projects.

types.title: Country Houses
types.desc: Homes built in rural areas, with designs that integrate regional architecture into the natural environment.

realEstate.cta: For information on available properties, contact us.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Plan your visit to Durania. We are ready to help you live the best experience.
